com.runesmith.building.runesmith.desc: Where the colony's enchanted books meet its gear. The Runesmith applies the Enchanter's books to the armor, weapons and tools in the racks, by the anvil's rules and without the XP.
runesmith:runesmith.job.desc: Takes enchanted books from the colony's stock and applies them to the armor, weapons and tools in the hut's racks, following the vanilla anvil rules. A book is only spent when the piece really changes.
runesmith:runesmith.skills.desc: Knowledge and Mana grow with the work. A higher building lets the Runesmith use stronger books.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: Helmets, chestplates, leggings and boots in the racks.
Swords, axes, maces, bows, crossbows and tridents in the racks.
Pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, shears and fishing rods in the racks.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.runesmi: Book level limited by building level:
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: A level N Runesmith only uses books whose enchantments are at most level N. Stronger books stay in the colony's stock until the building grows.
Gear that already carries any enchantment is left alone.
Each book also costs lapis lazuli, one per level of the book: a level I book one, a level V book five.

The Runesmith also walks to colonists, guards first, and enchants the armor they wear and the tool or weapon they hold. A worker's tool is left alone when the enchantment would make it too good for his hut.
